other_conditions: Bank account must be linked with Aadhaar number
Applicant must have a digital caste certificate
Class 10th examination result must be 60% or higher
Student must be eligible to take admission in class 10th after passing class 11th
benefits_summary: Coaching, accommodation and teaching facilities for scheduled‑tribe students in classes 11‑12 to prepare for national entrance examinations (JEE, NEET/AIIMS, CLET) at reputed institutes in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur and Gwalior.
